question: Read finding counts once at lifecycle recording, or parse reports again during planning?
alternatives: Persist an additive count on FinalReviewCompleted and consume events
Parse each report separately in lifecycle and planning
observation: failureRecord already consumes FinalReviewCompleted in a single event traversal; no existing report parser participates in planning. Persisting counts avoids a second parser and preserves immutable event evidence.
source: performance.now around reading scripts/lib/plan-failures.mjs and recording the inspected data path
